node: Data-center power delivery, grid interconnection, transformers, switchgear, and thermal infrastructure
summary: As of 2026-06-09, the underfollowed lane for AI data-center power constraints is no longer just Vertiv/Eaton/GE Vernova/Quanta. The small/mid-cap discovery set should include electrical contractors with substation and data-center C&I exposure, grid-interconnection engineering firms, transmission-line hardware suppliers, and domestic electrical-infrastructure component vendors. The strongest direct evidence in this pass is MYR Group's disclosed backlog and data-center C&I exposure; Willdan is a smaller engineering/consulting angle tied to data-center substation development and grid interconnection; Preformed Line Products is a second-order transmission/substation hardware supplier; Atkore is a hypothesis-level domestic electrical raceway/protection supplier that needs customer and project-level verification.
